title: Stop exporting the DeepSeek adapter's default constants at the package root
task:
Problem: packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/index.ts re-exports `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW`, `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS` and `DEFAULT_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` from src/adapter.ts (export block at index.ts:31-36) and exports `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` (index.ts:104). No file outside packages/llm/llm-deepseek imports any of them (grep for imports from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` across packages, apps and examples), the README documents the defaults as values in its config table rather than by these names, and the proposed prune note's grouped inventory already targets this package's helper exports.

Required: stop exporting the four constants at the package root while keeping them where the schema defaults and `resolveAdapterOptions` read them (index.ts:50-51, :96-99, :175, :187, :192-193): turn the re-export block into a plain import and make `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` a module-private const. Keep `DeepSeekAdapter`, `resolveAdapterOptions`, the type exports and the plugin contract exported. Run `pnpm run knip`; a constant it then reports as an unused export of adapter.ts stays exported there only if index.ts still imports it. No behavior change.

Constraints: no README change, no Agent Note; do not touch the twin adapter under packages/llm/llm-pi-ai.
